functionalRequirement: User shall be able to share files, screen share, conduct group screen sharing, and send contacts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support file sharing, screen sharing, group screen sharing, and contact sending for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive functionality for sharing and communication, necessitating full coverage of these features.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must initiate file sharing and screen sharing within 500 milliseconds for up to 50 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time sharing, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for file sharing, screen sharing, and contact sending, with clear icons and labels.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction with multiple features, necessitating ease of operation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all shared files and screen data using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sharing sensitive data, requiring protection during transmission.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to sign up and validate credentials, leading to access to the Snap camera screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate user credentials with 100% accuracy for valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires accurate credential validation to ensure secure access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process sign-up and credential validation requests in less than 300 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user authentication, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for user sign-up and credential validation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user authentication, necessitating robust security measures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide a step-by-step guide for new users during the sign-up process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user onboarding, requiring ease of learning for new users.

functionalRequirement: System shall provide an interface for Application Administrators to reset user passwords.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must allow Application Administrators to reset user passwords for 100% of user accounts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive functionality for password reset, necessitating full coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that password reset requests are logged and audited for unauthorized access.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive administrative actions, requiring data integrity and accountability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and simple interface for Application Administrators to reset user passwords.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires administrative interaction, necessitating ease of operation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to process password reset requests for 99.99% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical administrative functionality, necessitating high availability.

functionalRequirement: System shall be able to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information for the user, sites, and nearby sites.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must accurately calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites using all required geo-location data types (e.g., latitude, longitude) for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must provide distance calculations with an accuracy of within 1 meter for 99.9% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct distance calculations based on geo-location data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites in less than 100 milliseconds for up to 1,000 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to geo-location data and calculations, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 50 MB of memory to process geo-location data and distance calculations for a single request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple sites and users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear API or interface for accessing distance calculations and geo-location data, with consistent parameter naming (e.g., lat, lon) across all endpoints.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with geo-location data, which should be easy to operate for developers or users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to perform distance calculations and geo-location retrievals for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to geo-location services, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt user geo-location data using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing user location, which is sensitive data requiring protection.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide comprehensive information on requirements and services for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires thorough coverage of research and selection functionalities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must present requirements and services in a clear and organized manner, with intuitive navigation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user research, requiring ease of information recognition.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must provide a search function and filters to help users find relevant services or applications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user research, necessitating tools to assist in finding information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load and display service and requirement information in less than 1 second.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for researching and selecting services for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to service information, necessitating high availability.
